vehicle.title: Add your NIO vehicle
vehicle.description: Enter the vehicle identity after authorizing Home Assistant with NIO.

application_credentials.description: Create or open your Personal Application in the [NIO Open Telematics developer console]({console_url}), set its OAuth redirect URI exactly to [{redirect_url}]({redirect_url}), then enter its Client ID and Client Secret.

init.title: Vehicle dashboard
init.description: Optional vehicle and household sources. Leave a vehicle source empty to use its NIO entity automatically; connection and power can come from any HA charger, and EVCC is not required. History session import requires the EVCC-compatible format.

data.language: Dashboard language (auto follows each viewer's Home Assistant language)
data.soc_entity: State of charge entity (optional NIO override)
data.cost_solar: Recorded solar charging energy entity (cumulative kWh)
data.evcc_connected: Charger connected entity (EVCC or other HA source)
data.evcc_power: Charging power entity (EVCC or other HA source)
data.full_range_km: Range at full charge (km; ledger fallback)

error.ledger_calibration_required: Set usable battery capacity and full-charge range before enabling history.
error.incomplete_cost_sources: Set all five recorded-cost sources or leave them empty.
